The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1950–1951''' was contested by 60 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of each division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[PSV Eindhoven]] won this year's championship by beating [[AFC DWS|DWS]], [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]], [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]] and [[sc Heerenveen]].

At the end of this season, the [[KNVB]] re-aligned the current system of Divisions into 4 new Divisions for 1951–52, to be called Eerste Klasse A-D.

==New entrants==
This season, there was one division less than in the last one; this meant that all teams had to be reassigned.

'''Eerste Klasse A:'''
*Moving in from Division East: [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] and [[FC Zwolle|Zwolsche Boys]]
*Moving in from Division North: [[Achilles 1894]], [[Be Quick 1887]], [[LAC Frisia 1883]], [[FC Groningen|GVAV Rapiditas]], [[sc Heerenveen]], [[HSC (football club)|HSC]] [[VV Leeuwarden]], [[VV Sneek Wit Zwart|Sneek Wit Zwart]] and [[Velocitas 1897]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV Zwartemeer]]
'''Eerste Klasse B:'''
*Moving in from Division East: [[AGOVV Apeldoorn]], [[FC Twente|Enschedese Boys]], [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]], [[HVV Hengelo]], [[NEC Nijmegen]], [[Sportclub Enschede|SC Enschede]] and [[FC Wageningen]]
*Moving in from Division West-I: [[VV DOS|DOS]]
*Moving in from Division West-II: [[AFC Ajax]], [[AFC DWS|DWS]] and [[HVV 't Gooi]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Vitesse Arnhem]]
'''Eerste Klasse C:'''
*Moving in from Division West-I: [[ADO Den Haag]], [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[HFC Haarlem]], [[Hermes DVS]], [[KFC (football club)|KFC]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
*Moving in from Division West-II: [[HFC EDO]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]], [[Schiedamse Voetbal Vereniging|SVV]] and [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[ASV-DWV|DWV]]
'''Eerste Klasse D:'''
*Moving in from Division South-I: [[NOAD (football club)|NOAD]] and [[RBC Roosendaal]]
*Moving in from Division South-II: [[FC Den Bosch|BVV Den Bosch]], [[LONGA (football club)|NOAD]],  [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[TSC (football club)|TSC]] and [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]
*Moving in from West-I: [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
*Moving in from West-II: [[XerxesDZB|Xerxes]]
*Promoted form 2nd Division: [[Baronie/DNL|De Baronie]] & [[Emma (football club)|Emma]]
'''Eerste Klasse E:'''
*Moving in from Division South-I: [[RKVV Brabantia|Brabantia]], [[SC Helmondia]], [[MVV Maastricht]], [[PSV Eindhoven]], [[SV Limburgia]] and [[VVV Venlo]]
*Moving in from Division South-II: [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]], [[FC Eindhoven]], [[SC Emma]] and [[Maurits (football club)|Maurits]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VV Chèvremont]] & [[Fortuna Sittard|Sittardia]]
